newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Minfeng to list 22.5 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Minfeng to list 22.5 mln A shares.

text.p: Shanghai Minfeng Holding Co 600781.SS, a textile joint venture with partners from Taiwan, Hong Kong and Shanghai, will list 22.5 million A shares on Wednesday in Shanghai, a company official said on Tuesday.

The shares, issued at a price of 4.90 yuan per share in November, would raise a total of 90.3 million yuan, which will be used mainly to enlarge the company's printing and dyeing capacity, the official said.

After the issue, the company will have a total share capital of 86.89 million shares, including 22.5 million A shares, 27.19 million shares held by Taiwan Min Hsing Cotton Mill, 24.47 million by Shanghai No.10 Printing & Dyeing Factory and 2.71 million by Hong Kong Mansheen Industry Ltd.
